summary: Comprehensive Mobile Web UX Audit & Fix Plan for plato's high-traffic routes (Learner Classroom & Lesson Chat, Authentication & Onboarding), aligned with the October 19, 2026 Mobile Web UX Audit Contract. Covers safe code-verified fixes for touch targets, viewport/safe-area clearance, form ergonomics, input survival, and image/layout stability, plus proposed device-dependent diffs and a prioritized 10-entry physical device check script.
